mode: Built-in image generation; no application API calls

initial_prompts.01-two-ai-phases: Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a friendly, beautifully legible hand-drawn editorial illustration for GitHub Manager, wide landscape, white paper, black ink doodles, indigo and blue handwritten headings, soft lavender/light-blue marker accents and generous whitespace. Match a thoughtful architectural sketchnote with semantic little illustrations, not dense block diagrams. Exact title: 'Agree on the vocabulary. Then organize the repositories.' Two clearly separated horizontal illustrated routes. Upper route heading '1 · Taxonomy discovery'. Show three README papers labeled 'orion-api', 'orion-ui', 'orion-booking', a small friendly AI robot with concept cards, a person holding an edit/approve clipboard, then an approved vocabulary notebook. Exact step labels: 'Collection evidence' -> 'Proposed concepts' -> 'You review' -> 'Approved vocabulary'. In the robot's two concept cards write 'Clinical Operations' and 'Orion Clinical Platform'. Lower route heading '2 · Repository classification'. Show one README paper, a magnifying glass over vocabulary cards, a robot selecting labels, and a person reviewing those labels. Exact step labels: 'One repository' -> 'Retrieve candidates' -> 'Select supported IDs' -> 'Review assignments'. Show four selected chips 'Orion', 'Web APIs', 'FastAPI', 'Python'. A clear thin arrow from upper approved notebook into lower magnifying glass indicates classification uses the approved vocabulary. Bottom short note: 'Domains derive through Projects.' Footer: 'GitHub Manager · illustrative workflow'. No cloud, embeddings, vector database, auto-publication, tool loop, invented cost or performance numbers. Do not connect a generated draft directly to applied assignments without the human review. Large readable labels; no small paragraphs.
initial_prompts.02-data-through-classification: Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a clean friendly hand-drawn editorial sketchnote for GitHub Manager showing understandable actual sample data, wide landscape, white paper, black pen doodles, indigo/blue handwritten headings and soft light-blue/lavender marker accents. Exact title: 'Follow one repository into the model'. Arrange four large scenes in a spacious two-by-two reading path with clear arrows and numbered steps, without dense technical architecture boxes. Scene 1 top left: README paper heading '1 · Preserve purpose', exact readable evidence text in two lines 'Patient intake API for Orion.' and 'Uses FastAPI and Python.' A small ID chip says 'E1'. Scene 2 top right: magnifying glass over candidate cards, heading '2 · Retrieve possibilities'. Cards say 'Orion', 'Forge', 'Web APIs', 'Package Management', 'FastAPI', 'Python'. Short note 'A shortlist is not a decision'. Scene 3 bottom left: an open prompt envelope heading '3 · Assemble the request'. Three items entering it: 'Evidence + phrases', 'Candidate IDs + definitions', 'Instructions + schema'. Short note 'Count and reserve before generation'. Scene 4 bottom right: robot handing a structured result to a person, heading '4 · Review supported labels'. Four checked chips 'Orion', 'Web APIs', 'FastAPI', 'Python'. 'Forge' and 'Package Management' remain visibly unselected. Small evidence chip 'Cites E1'. Footer exact: 'Authored synthetic fixture · actual saved classification result'. Make the graphic follow 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4 explicitly, no shortcut from retrieval to assignments, no LLM-produced facts outside evidence. Do not show made-up probabilities or retrieval scores. Keep all specified labels spelled correctly, readable at ordinary article width.

correction_prompt: Edit this illustration with narrowly targeted factual corrections. Preserve its white-paper hand-drawn style, colors, two-row layout, all principal scenes, people, arrows, headings and overall dimensions. Change the approved vocabulary notebook's four tabs to exactly 'Domains', 'Projects', 'Topics', 'Tags' in that order; replace the incorrect Products, Components, Technologies labels. Show the lower candidate cards as 'Orion', 'Forge', 'Web APIs', 'FastAPI', 'Python'; no Domain card. Keep the top proposed 'Clinical Operations' Domain and 'Orion Clinical Platform' Project unchanged; they belong in discovery. Remove the unsupported decorative marketing phrases in the top-right and bottom-left corners, leaving clean whitespace or the existing little doodle alone. Keep the exact bottom note 'Domains derive through Projects.' and footer 'GitHub Manager · illustrative workflow'. No new slogans, features, probabilities or cloud elements. This is a correctness edit, not a redesign.
